selected.item: Microsoft made Aion Instruct generally available on November 19, 2026, as an open-weights model on Hugging Face and as Microsoft Edge's built-in small language model, replacing Phi-4-mini. Aion Instruct is a 2.3B-parameter model, smaller and faster than Phi and able to run on many more devices, with comparable quality for common web tasks such as text synthesis and generation, summarization, instruction following and structured outputs. Edge downloads Aion Instruct only when a site or feature first needs it and only on devices that can run it well; users can turn off on-device AI in Edge settings, which removes the model and stops future downloads. Aion is also coming to Windows later in 2026. The same post opens an origin trial for the Prompt API (previously a developer preview only in Edge Canary and Dev) so developers can call Aion Instruct from a live site, and a developer preview of an experimental Decisions API powered by Aion Instruct, which answers yes/no, multiple-choice or scoring questions about text in a single pass, returning probabilities and a confidence value without generating text. Aion Instruct builds on the earlier Aion-1.0-Instruct developer preview, refined with early-adopter feedback. It is not one of the seven MAI models covered in No.33 (Code 2, Code 2 Flash, Cyber 2 Flash, Image 2.7, Realtime 1, Transcribe 2, Decision 1.1). The blog post states no price.
selected.note: The Edge blog carries the November 19, 2026 date only, so no announcement time is asserted. No price is stated in the post.

selected.item: Google added voice editing to Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (gemini-3.5-transcribe) and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live (gemini-3.5-transcribe-live) on November 17, 2026, per the Gemini API changelog. Voice editing lets users edit, rewrite or format dictated speech or pre-existing text (source_text) with spoken instructions, and is enabled by default in Smart transcription mode, according to the transcription documentation. Gemini 3.5 Transcribe supports automatic language identification across 85+ locales, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, custom vocabulary hints and smart transcription (disfluency removal and formatting). This is a capability addition to existing models, not a new model. This is the first coverage in this series: the No.34 sweep (November 20) recorded the changelog's latest entries as November 19 and 18 and missed this November 17 item, so it is introduced here with its original November 17 date clearly stated, not presented as a November 19, 20 or 21 announcement.
selected.note: The Gemini API changelog carries the November 17, 2026 date only, so no announcement time is asserted. No price is stated for voice editing in the changelog.
